title: Support multi-word stage labels/aliases in generic deterministic DSL

close_reason: Closed

title: Canonicalize field aliases across set/json/raw JSON
description: Turn field alias metadata into real runtime behavior. Build canonical field maps from StageSpec.field_specs and manifest-level field_aliases, then rewrite alias keys to canonical field paths in set, json <stage> {...}, and raw JSON shortcut flows. Unknown keys should only survive if they are already canonical, and alias collisions must be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: - Alias-based input lands in canonical draft keys\n- No silent 'accepted but ignored later' behavior remains\n- Alias collisions are rejected during validation

title: Make startup discovery tolerant to broken external extensions
description: Keep strict discovery for tests and tooling, but add a tolerant startup path so one broken or duplicate external extension cannot brick the whole app. The tolerant loader should quarantine invalid providers, preserve working ones, always retain built-in default_or, and expose startup warnings through logs or service state.
acceptance_criteria: - A bad third-party extension is quarantined instead of being fatal\n- The app still boots with default_or plus every valid extension\n- Startup warnings are visible in logs and accessible from app/service state

title: Add independent-extension viability regression suite
description: Encode the independent-extension review findings as permanent tests. title: Support structured non-dict extension results in session/API
description: Stop degrading non-default extension results to {'repr': ...}. Widen generic extension result transport so student extensions can return structured outputs without losing semantics. Preserve plain JSON values directly, serialize dataclasses via asdict, serialize Pydantic models via model_dump(mode='json'), and only fall back to repr with an explicit warning when no structured form is available.
acceptance_criteria: - Extension results remain structured in /api/chat/turn and /api/session/...\n- Dataclass and Pydantic extension results both round-trip into JSON\n- Existing default_or behavior remains unchanged
close_reason: Closed

title: Implement real preset loading contract for non-default extensions

If a provider advertises a default preset in strict mode, it must be able to load it.
acceptance_criteria: - load preset demo works for a non-default extension that declares default_preset\n- In strict mode, a provider that declares default_preset but cannot load it fails discovery or startup loudly\n- sample_study_planner_extension ships with one working built-in preset
